2004 Volvo S80 · 2.5T Sedan 4D
$2,000 - 81501

Good car for around town, I’ve had it for 2 years but it’s time for an upgrade! This would be a good first car or a car for driving from point A to B in town for. Not the prettiest or fastest car in town, but it’s practical for travel because of its good gas mileage. Haz 188,270 miles but it’ll go up as I drive it. I’m willing to negotiate price if it’s reasonable, cash is preferred but we can always work out payment also. Let me know! The worst I can do is kindly decline your offer haha! Priced to sell! 

-the engine and trans are solid
-the muffler fell off so it’s got no muffler (sounds a little loud)

Pros:

-GOOD gas milage and gas tank capacity 
-has a decent top speed (130 mph)
-blows really cold and really hot air
-strong engine/transmission 
-new radiator (4 months ago)
-large trunk space
-regular oil changes
-no smoking in the car
-comes with wireless ANKER charger for your phone
-has some pretty dark tint on the back windows and rear windshield

Message me for the cons list!

1987 GulfStream  .
$1,000 - 81507

1987 Gulfstream Boat with Trailer – Project Boat – OBO

Selling my 1987 Gulfstream boat with trailer. The trailer is in good shape. The boat ran last year, but I haven’t had the time or energy to finish getting it back on the water.

It is not currently running. I have a brand-new carburetor that needs to be installed, and it will go with the boat.

The seats will need to be redone, making this a good project for someone who wants to put in a little work and get an older boat back on the water.

Boat Details:

    ●    1987 Gulfstream
    ●    OMC 260
    ●    Ran last year
    ●    New carburetor included; needs to be installed
    ●    Not currently running
    ●    Seats need to be redone
    ●    Selling as-is

Trailer Details:

    ●    Trailer included
    ●    Trailer date of manufacture: 6/12/1987
    ●    5,000-lb GVWR
    ●    Trailer is in good shape

I simply don’t have the time to finish the project, so my loss is someone else’s opportunity. $1000 obo/trade
